summary: Iteration 18: Complete testing of Requests and Freelancer Database features under 'Tools at mach'. All backend tests passed (19/19). All frontend tests passed. Both new features are fully functional with proper RBAC enforcement.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Two new features under 'Tools at mach' are fully functional: REQUESTS allows team members to submit asset/tool/licence/subscription requests with photo upload, 3-line justification, 7-day lead time enforcement. Only admin (sanat@) can approve/reject/hold. Approval requires vendor details and registered company confirmation. FREELANCERS is admin-only section storing 3D and post-production freelancers with 20 service types. Regular users and managers see 'Access Restricted' message. All CRUD operations work correctly with proper RBAC enforcement.
